content: Perhaps the greatest tragedy in the lead up to World War I was how the widespread expectation of a great European war paradoxically left the West genuinely stunned when one finally broke out. In less than 10 years, there were at least five instances where the Great Powers nearly came to blows. There was the First Moroccan Crisis in 1905-1906, the Bosnian Crisis in 1908-1909, the Second Moroccan Crisis in 1911, and finally two Balkan Wars from 1912–13. By July 1914, Europeans had become so accustomed to the fact that every few years, the newspapers would run front page headlines about an impending war, only for disaster to be averted at the 11th hour. This meant they had basically learned the wrong lesson that these things always get sorted out. So when things finally did explode, it caught tens of millions of people off guard. It’s like being told for 20 years that a major financial catastrophe is just around the corner and each time it’s put off until you think such a disaster will never actually happen, only for it to finally strike one day exactly as the last 20 years worth of predictions foretold.

We need to have a general understanding of what is happening with the Russians to realize that they will resort to anything. There will be hundreds, thousands of cyberattacks, missile pressure will be used, there will be intimidation, and so on. They do not change. Why? Putin still cannot find a victory in this war. Unfortunately, we have to acknowledge and understand what is happening. He is thinking about mobilization. He is thinking about how to deceive his own people. How to carry out mass mobilization without actually announcing it. How to introduce some kind of shadow contracts, close the borders, and so on. We see this. We are already seeing many such moves. He needs to sell a victory. He will not have a victory in Ukraine. He needs to seize Donbas. We are not going to withdraw on our own. So what can he sell as a victory? He will twist those Anchorage terms that they discussed with the American side, with the President of the United States. No one is going to abandon their country, their people, and simply walk away. Because no one can guarantee that this man will not go further. From an interview for the United News telethon. (2/3)

The Russians have concentrated three rings of air defense around Moscow. To create such a strong defensive shield, they had to pull all their air defense systems from every corner of their vast territory. For Moscow, and to a lesser extent for St. Petersburg. But no matter how much air defense you have, it runs out of ammunition anyway, and we will still find technologies to respond to them so that they feel it. After they began striking our logistics, we found another logistics operation and responded. Their losses there are staggering – one trillion rubles. It was a very successful operation by Ukrainian forces. It involved the Armed Forces, the Special Operations Forces, the Defense Intelligence of Ukraine, the Security Service of Ukraine, and the Foreign Intelligence Service. Today, we operate jointly when carrying out the relevant deep strikes and mid-range strikes. From an interview for the United News telethon. (1/3)

Greetings to everyone on National Handloom Day. Instituted in 2015 under the visionary leadership of Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, this day celebrates India's rich handloom heritage, the exceptional craftsmanship of our weavers, and the spirit of self-reliance. It also commemorates the launch of the Swadeshi Movement in 1905, which inspired the nation to embrace indigenous products and strengthen economic self-reliance. PM Modi has consistently championed India's handloom sector through the vision of "Vocal for Local." Through several transformative initiatives, our Government has been promoting handloom products, expanding market access, improving weavers' welfare, preserving traditional crafts, and encouraging every citizen to make locally made products an integral part of everyday life. Let us celebrate our weavers, preserve India's timeless weaving traditions, and reaffirm our commitment to Vocal for Local by proudly choosing handloom products.

The problem is, we have the worst of both worlds. It’d be one thing to swamp the country in mass immigration and deny people’s basic expectation for social cohesion in exchange for cheap, luxury convenience. (Still bad, but at least there’s a coherent trade-off). But you don’t get that. You get mass immigration plus ever-shrinking paths to upward social mobility. The cheapness/convenience you do get are either grossly unevenly distributed and/or trivial—TVs and ultra processed foods and poorly made consumer goods. At some point the right will have to face some hard choices about what it’s willing to give up to radically reduce immigration and tighten our spending (these costs exist but are mostly exaggerated), but that is not what’s at stake here. The exorbitant cost to live a decent life in Current Year America—not the cost of living per se, but the cost of the American Dream—is skyrocketing as a result of Richard’s preferred immigration policies, not because of them. “Rahhhh-ger CLARA Ship…the deck is moving.” Landing Signals Officers, aka “Paddles,” are the heartbeat of a Carrier Air Wing. Sometimes they give you an arguably undeserved bad grade (what do you mean that was a “full high” at the start…I had a rails pass all the way down!). And then they save your life. I met my first squadron off the coast of Japan in Feb 2008. I had a grand total of 22 Super Hornet traps under my belt and was thrust into the big leagues at the tender age of 26. Winter in the Sea of Japan is tough. The cold weather meant we needed to wear impermeable, full-body rubber suits under our flight gear, providing survival time if we had to eject into the frigid water. It also meant the seas were rough and the cloud cover was often low. A perfect mix for a young “nugget” pilot like myself to get himself into trouble when landing. To be blunt, I started as a below average ball flyer. My landing grades were bad. And then I got launched into a marginal weather day in pitching deck conditions. The flight itself was uneventful. But the 75 minutes of flight time was overshadowed by the inevitable need to land back on the ship in what we knew were going to be sporty conditions. The 5 minutes before landing was spent completely in the clouds. We only had one navigation aide available that day due to ships maintenance, so the air traffic controllers talked us down to a point where they handed us off to the LSOs. The controller ended with an abrupt “you’re at three quarters of a mile…on glide slope, on centerline, call the ball.” I couldn’t see the ship. Mustering as much confidence as I could in that terrifying moment, I abruptly pushed over the radio “CLARA ship.” CLARA means you can’t see something. “CLARA ship” means I couldn’t see the ship. And I was 15 seconds to landing, traveling 150 miles per hour, with a 700 foot per minute descent rate. Then the voice of CAG Paddles calmly slid into my ears: “Rahhhh-ger CLARA ship…the deck is moving. You’re a little high, easy with it.” This tested, 32 year old man, standing on the back of the ship, had my landing light in sight, and started smoothly talking me down. He also noted that the carrier deck was pitching up and down…implying he was gonna get me aboard safely. Those surreal moments passed with confident, directive, but calming words pouring into my headset that my hands and eyes instinctively responded to. The hundreds of practice passes learning that guidance made the real thing automatic. Suddenly, the ship appeared and a moment later we jerked to a stop. We had landed. “Nice work 107.” Thanks Paddles. For getting me aboard safely and saving my life. I never disputed a landing grade after that. Fly Navy. Video

El ministro de Hacienda entrante se la ha pasado insinuando que Colombia está algo “llevada”. Es evidente que están construyendo un relato con frases como: “Lo que recibo es malo, muy malo”, “Hubo una parranda de cuatro años y ahora viene el guayabo”, “El Estado es financieramente inviable”. Aunque evitan pronunciar la palabra quiebra, el mensaje que buscan posicionar es exactamente ese, y quiero ser claro, no estoy siendo ligero con el déficit. Para sostener esa tesis, apelan a The Economist, una publicación que evaluó 43 economías, sí solo cuarenta y tres, y en cuya muestra Colombia aparece de tercera con un déficit del 6,6%. Lo que omiten es que The Economist dejó por fuera a más de 150 naciones, incluyendo justamente a las que registran los mayores desbalances del planeta: economías en guerra, en colapso o microestados. Ahora bien, el Fondo Monetario Internacional publica dos veces al año el World Economic Outlook con cerca de 190 países, y en ese mapa global Colombia ni siquiera entra en el Top 10. Insistir en que el país podría estar en la ruina cumple tres objetivos políticos muy concretos, están trasladando toda la responsabilidad a la administración saliente, quieren reducir las expectativas ciudadanas frente a las promesas de campaña y le abre paso a recortes en el gasto social que tendrían un costo político insostenible. Mientras tanto, la economía real muestra otra cara, el desempleo bajó en junio, la pobreza continúa cayendo y el PIB acumula tres años en terreno positivo. El déficit fiscal existe y hay que gestionarlo con rigor, la verdadera discusión es sobre los hombros de quién va a caer el peso del ajuste del que tanto hablan y amenazan.

Iran's Supreme National Security Council has outlined six conditions it says must be met before the Strait of Hormuz will be reopened to commercial shipping: 1. Cease all threats and insults toward Iran. 2. Permanently end what Iran describes as its "war of aggression" against Iran and its allies in Lebanon, Palestine, Iraq, and Yemen. 3. Lift the naval blockade of Iran and withdraw all U.S. naval and air forces operating around the country. 4. Pay reparations for damage caused during the conflict. 5. Lift all sanctions imposed on Iran. 6. "Unconditionally" release all frozen Iranian assets. The demands underscore the significant gap that remains between the two sides. Several of the conditions, including ending the U.S. military presence in the region, lifting sanctions, and paying reparations, would represent major shifts in longstanding U.S. policy, making a near term resolution to the Strait of Hormuz crisis appear unlikely.

‘सहकारातून समृद्धी’चा संकल्प; शहरी सहकारी बँकिंगच्या आधुनिकीकरणाला वेग केंद्रीय गृह व सहकार मंत्री अमित शाह यांच्या हस्ते आणि मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत आज मुंबई येथे सहकार नव-क्रांती कार्यक्रमाचा शुभारंभ पार पडला. अर्बन को-ऑपरेटिव्ह बँकिंग क्षेत्राला आधुनिक, पारदर्शक, विश्वासार्ह आणि तंत्रज्ञानाधिष्ठित बनविण्यासाठी ‘अंब्रेला ऑर्गनायझेशन’ महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावणार आहे. या माध्यमातून देशातील प्रत्येक तहसीलपर्यंत अर्बन को-ऑपरेटिव्ह बँकिंगचे जाळे विस्तारण्यास मोठी चालना मिळेल, असा विश्वास केंद्रीय गृह व सहकार मंत्री अमित शाह यांनी व्यक्त केला. देशातील अर्बन को-ऑपरेटिव्ह बँकिंग क्षेत्रासाठी महत्त्वपूर्ण निर्णय घेत, राष्ट्रीय शहरी सहकारी वित्त व विकास महामंडळाचे मुख्यालय दिल्लीहून महाराष्ट्रात हलवण्यात येईल, अशी घोषणा केंद्रीय मंत्री अमित शाह यांनी यावेळी केली. केंद्रीय मंत्री अमित शाह म्हणाले, देशातील प्रत्येक अर्बन को-ऑपरेटिव्ह बँकेने, अगदी एका शाखेच्या बँकेनेही अंब्रेला ऑर्गनायझेशनचे सदस्यत्व घ्यावे. सदस्यत्व घेतल्यानंतर सुरक्षा संचालन केंद्राशी (सिक्युरिटी ऑपरेशन सेंटर) जोडले जावे. यामुळे बँकांमधील ठेवीदारांचा विश्वास वाढण्यास मदत होईल आणि बँकिंग क्षेत्र अधिक सुरक्षित होईल. देशातील 1400 अर्बन को-ऑपरेटिव्ह बँकांमध्ये सुमारे ₹6,00,000 कोटींच्या ठेवी आहेत. देशाच्या आर्थिक विकासात या बँकांची भूमिका अत्यंत महत्त्वाची आहे. छोटे दुकानदार, व्यापारी, कुटीर उद्योग, एमएसएमई, स्थानिक व्यावसायिक, महिला बचत गट तसेच मध्यमवर्गीयांच्या विविध गरजा पूर्ण करण्यासाठी छोट्या कर्जांची आवश्यकता असते. मोठ्या बँकांना अनेकदा या गरजा पूर्ण करणे शक्य होत नाही; मात्र तालुका पातळीवरील अर्बन को-ऑपरेटिव्ह बँका ही भूमिका प्रभावीपणे पार पाडू शकतात. कर्जाची रक्कम जितकी कमी, तितकी परतफेडीची शक्यता अधिक असते. कोणत्याही हमी किंवा तारणाशिवाय कर्ज देण्याची कमाल मर्यादा आता ₹2.5 लाखांवरून ₹5 लाख करण्यात आली आहे. या योजनेतील तब्बल 99.78% कर्जांची व्याजासह परतफेड झाली आहे. यावरून छोट्या कर्जदारांची कर्जफेडीची क्षमता स्पष्ट होते, असे केंद्रीय मंत्री अमित शाह यांनी नमूद केले. केंद्रीय मंत्री अमित शाह म्हणाले, महाराष्ट्रात 449 सहकारी बँका असून देशातील सहकारी बँकिंग क्षेत्रात महाराष्ट्राचे मोठे योगदान आहे. महाराष्ट्रासह गुजरात, गोवा आणि कर्नाटक या राज्यांमध्ये देशातील मोठ्या प्रमाणावर शहरी सहकारी बँका कार्यरत आहेत. त्यामुळे शहरी सहकारी बँकिंग क्षेत्राच्या अंब्रेला संस्थेचे मुख्यालय महाराष्ट्रात असणे अधिक उपयुक्त ठरेल. देशातील शहरी सहकारी बँकांना ‘अंब्रेला ऑर्गनायझेशन’च्या माध्यमातून एकत्र आणण्याचे उद्दिष्ट आहे. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांनी 2047 पर्यंत विकसित भारताचे स्वप्न पाहिले आहे. ‘सहकारातून समृद्धी’चा अर्थ केवळ बँक किंवा संस्थेची समृद्धी नसून, बँकेच्या ग्राहकाला समृद्ध करणे हा आहे. शहरी सहकारी बँकिंग क्षेत्राला आधुनिक, सुरक्षित, पारदर्शक आणि जागतिक स्तरावर सक्षम करण्यासाठी ‘अंब्रेला ऑर्गनायझेशन’च्या माध्यमातून आज महत्त्वपूर्ण सुरुवात झाली आहे, असेही केंद्रीय मंत्री शाह यांनी नमूद केले. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, केंद्रीय राज्यमंत्री कृष्णपाल गुर्जर, केंद्रीय राज्यमंत्री मुरलीधर मोहोळ, मंत्री बाबासाहेब पाटील, मंत्री जयकुमार रावल, राष्ट्रीय नागरी सहकारी वित्त आणि विकास महामंडळाचे अध्यक्ष ज्योतिंद्र मेहता व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @AmitShah @Dev_Fadnavis @mieknathshinde @KPGBJP @mohol_murlidhar @babasahebpati1 @JaykumarRawal @ShelarAshish #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Mumbai

महाराष्ट्र-मेघालय मैत्रीचा नवा अध्याय, नवी मुंबईत मेघालय भवनाची पायाभरणी मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज नवी मुंबई येथे नवीन मेघालय भवनाच्या उभारणीसाठी महाराष्ट्र सरकारकडून मेघालय सरकारकडे नवी मुंबई येथील भूखंडाचे हस्तांतरण करण्यात आले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस आणि मेघालयचे मुख्यमंत्री कॉनराड के. संगमा यांनी नवीन मेघालय भवनाची पायाभरणी केली. महाराष्ट्र आणि ईशान्य भारतातील मेघालय ही केवळ दोन राज्ये नसून, ‘एक भारत, श्रेष्ठ भारत’ या संकल्पनेला मूर्त रूप देणारी सहोदर राज्ये आहेत, अशा शब्दांत महाराष्ट्र आणि मेघालय यांच्यातील सांस्कृतिक व आर्थिक नाते अधिक दृढ होत असल्याचे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. नवी मुंबई, ठाणे आणि रायगडचा संपूर्ण परिसर देशाच्या भविष्यातील अर्थव्यवस्थेला मोठी गती देणार असून, हाच परिसर भारताच्या विकासाचे पुढील मुख्य केंद्र ठरणार आहे, असा विश्वास मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, ईशान्य भारतातील विद्यार्थी, कलाकार आणि संगीत क्षेत्रातील दिग्गजांसाठी मुंबई व पुणे ही अत्यंत पसंतीची ठिकाणे आहेत. विशेषतः मेघालयच्या आत्म्यामध्ये वसलेल्या संगीताचा मुंबईच्या संगीत जगताशी अत्यंत जिव्हाळ्याचा संबंध आहे. त्यामुळेच खारघरसारख्या मोक्याच्या ठिकाणी आकारास येणारे हे मेघालय भवन केवळ एक इमारत नसून, मेघालयातून शिक्षणासाठी, वैद्यकीय उपचारांसाठी किंवा कला सादरीकरणासाठी येणाऱ्या नागरिक व विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी हक्काचे घर ठरेल. नवी मुंबई परिसरात होत असलेल्या अभूतपूर्व विकासाचा उल्लेख करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, या भागात जागतिक दर्जाच्या 12 अव्वल विद्यापीठांचा समावेश असलेली ‘एज्यु-सिटी’ आणि आंतरराष्ट्रीय दर्जाची ‘मेडी-सिटी’ उभारली जात आहे. सोबतच देशातील 60 टक्के डेटा सेंटर क्षमता याच परिसरात निर्माण होत असून, हे क्षेत्र न्यू-एज आणि डीप-टेक उद्योगांचे केंद्र बनत आहे. पुढील काळात मेघालयचे नागरिक या वास्तूचा वापर करतील, तेव्हा या नियोजित आणि भविष्याभिमुख जागेचे महत्त्व त्यांना जाणवेल. मेघालय भवनाचे बांधकाम लवकरात लवकर आणि उत्कृष्ट दर्जात पूर्ण करण्यासाठी सिडको किंवा राज्य सरकारच्या यंत्रणांमार्फत सर्वतोपरी सहकार्य केले जाईल, असे आश्वासनही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी मेघालयचे माजी मुख्यमंत्री व लोकसभेचे माजी अध्यक्ष स्व. पी. ए. संगमा यांच्या संसदेतील अतुलनीय योगदानाचे स्मरण केले. अत्यंत खडतर राजकीय परिस्थितीतही चेहऱ्यावर हास्य ठेवून त्यांनी देशाची संसद For Ashley, victory no longer means simply reaching a finish line. It’s having the strength to play with her daughter, spend a day at the beach with her family, finish a workout or stay up late watching TV with her husband. A 17-year-old African student has been charged and placed in pretrial detention after attacking three women near the Villiers-sur-Marne train station, east of Paris, between June 17 and July 23. The first victim, 26, was attacked while walking home after traveling from Paris. Police later recovered DNA from her clothing. A month later, a 29-year-old woman was attacked in the same area. She had activated her phone’s audio recorder after becoming suspicious, and a nearby resident’s intervention caused the assailant to flee. Police then deployed officers around the station. They followed the suspect as he approached women and arrested him after he attacked a third woman, 31, with a knife. Investigators say the teenager admitted the three attacks during questioning and mentioned another possible victim from early June.

A commercial vessel was reportedly attacked and caught fire while attempting to transit the US-secured lane in the Strait of Hormuz -UKMTO NASA’s FIRMS detected a drifting fire near the report location late last night.

The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) Center has issued an advisory after receiving a report that a vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz was struck, resulting in a fire approximately 18 nautical miles east of Khasab, Oman yesterday evening. According to UKMTO, the fire has since been extinguished, all crew members and the vessel are safe, and no environmental pollution has been reported. The reported location closely matches an area where NASA's FIRMS satellite system detected a significant heat signature at approximately 1733 UTC yesterday, suggesting the two reports may be related. The incident occurred in a section of the Strait that has seen multiple recent attacks by Iran on ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz using Omani waters.

Hundreds, thousands of components in Russian ballistic missiles come from different countries around the world – from almost every continent – including from our close partners. These components are then used to target people, killing children, civilians, and warriors alike. That is why imposing sanctions on Russian weapons and on the supply of these components is the top priority. Sanctions on the energy sector are important too, because they make money from it and spend that money on the war. Next, there's the issue of bureaucracy. This is a serious problem. For example, I spoke with President Biden in the first year of the war, and I strongly urged him to grant me licenses for Patriot. I spoke with several European partners in the first and second years of the war, when we began using some of their military technology, and asked them to grant me licenses because their production is very limited, and some problems still have not been resolved. We have now reached an agreement with President Trump that he will grant the licenses, but imagine if we had received them four years ago. By now, we would already be producing Patriots for everyone. And Europe – Europe that wants and would like to have Patriots, anti-ballistic systems, and missiles – would already have it all. I am absolutely certain of that. But now we are dealing with paperwork. And what is flying at us is not a piece of paper, not a paper missile, but a real missile that kills people. So if we say that the Americans should provide them, then the Europeans should as well – because with them, too, we have been working for a long time to resolve the issue of certain licenses. From answers to journalists’ questions. (2/2)

We have been living in a constant search for protection against ballistic missiles since the first days of the war, when Ukraine had nothing to intercept them with. This is extremely difficult work. How can this problem be solved? Who has anti-ballistic missiles and systems? The manufacturer does. That is the United States, first and foremost. Can they help? We are working on it. Every month. Will they provide us with missiles? Yes. We have arrangements under PURL. Are these missiles enough? No. In 2026, there are fewer of these missiles. Monthly deliveries were higher in 2025. The second part of this is Europe. Who has them? Germany has them. Poland has them. These are the countries that can provide serious help. With all due respect and gratitude to the German side, they truly have helped. And Poland has helped as well. But I will be frank. We are constantly working with the Nordic countries and the Netherlands, and they are helping little by little. Every day I communicate with various European and Middle Eastern countries to ensure that Ukraine receives additional aid packages outside of the PURL framework. We have simply reached the point where all of our institutions must be working on this. Not just the President. Everyone has to work. Otherwise, there will not be enough missiles. South Korea and Japan could also help. Have they helped us with air defense during this war? No. Because of their domestic legislation. People also frequently ask about Israel. We would like to receive air defense systems from them as well. We would be ready to buy them. So far, we do not have that opportunity, although we are in dialogue. From answers to journalists’ questions. (1/2)

They are the foundation of culture, identity and spiritual heritage, passed from generation to generation. Effective climate and environmental action depends on recognizing Indigenous knowledge and ensuring Indigenous Peoples can participate in decisions that shape their future. The UN Human Rights Indigenous Fellowship Programme equips Indigenous leaders with the knowledge, networks and tools to translate international human rights standards into lasting change in their communities. #WATCH | Kathmandu, Nepal: Tributes have continued to pour in for the Nepali climbers who died in an avalanche on Broad Peak. On Saturday morning, hundreds of people took part in the Tribute Run 5K in memory of the climbers who perished in the avalanche that struck the world’s 12th-highest peak at the end of July. Upon reaching Bouddhanath Stupa, the finish line of the run, participants held a vigil and lit butter-fed lamps in front of photographs of the deceased climbers. Portraits of British-Nepali climber Nirmal Purja, Nima Sherpa, Nawang Thindu Sherpa, Pur Bahadur Gurung, Kili Pemba Sherpa and Gyalu Sherpa were placed facing the UNESCO World Heritage Site. Participants paid their respects and observed a moment of remembrance for the climbers. Video

Під час зустрічей із Президентом Сербії Александром Вучичем сьогодні та вчора говорили про конкретні речі, які можуть додати міцності нашій інфраструктурі – портам і залізницям в обох країнах, про розвиток економік, відбудову та створення робочих місць в Україні та Сербії. Працюємо, щоб уже до кінця цього року підготувати все для укладання угоди про зону вільної торгівлі. Окремо обговорили виклики прийдешньої зими, коли через російські удари в Україні практично не залишилося цілих теплових електростанцій і ворог націлений на те, щоб зробити життя людей нестерпним. Що б не відбувалося, треба давати людям усі можливості жити, тому наша енергетична співпраця має велике значення. Дякую пану Президенту за конструктивний діалог і новий пакет гуманітарної підтримки для України, зокрема у сфері медицини та енергетики. Також торкнулися відносин із Євросоюзом. Будемо раді, якщо шлях Сербії в ЄС прискориться. Важливо, щоб кожен народ у Європі отримував чіткий сигнал, що він Європі потрібен і що нікого не можна втратити.

During our meetings with President of Serbia @avucic – today and yesterday – we discussed specific things that can strengthen our infrastructure, including ports and railways in both countries, as well as economic development, reconstruction, and job creation in Ukraine and Serbia. We are working to have everything ready by the end of this year to conclude an agreement on a free trade area. We separately discussed the challenges of the coming winter, when, because of Russian strikes, virtually no thermal power plants in Ukraine remain intact and the enemy is intent on making people’s lives unbearable. Whatever happens, people must be given every opportunity to live, so our energy cooperation is of great significance. I thank Mr. President for the constructive dialogue and for a new package of humanitarian support for Ukraine, particularly in the areas of healthcare and energy. We also discussed relations with the European Union. We will be glad if Serbia’s path toward EU membership accelerates. It is important that every nation in Europe receives a clear signal that Europe needs it and that no one can be lost. Video

Following the morning festivities of 59th ASEAN Day Celebrations, Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, also received a delegation participating in the ASEAN-Korea Journalists Exchange Programme, organised by the ASEAN-Korea Centre (AKC). The visiting journalists also attended the ASEAN Day commemorative activities at the ASEAN Secretariat/ASEAN Headquarters. During the meeting, SG Dr. Kao highlighted the media's role in fostering greater public understanding and strengthening cooperation between ASEAN and the Republic of Korea (ROK), particularly in the areas of culture, trade, innovation, and people-to-people connectivity. The ASEAN-Korea Journalist Exchange Programme is an ongoing initiative that seeks to deepen regional media networks and promote accurate, balanced and informed coverage of ASEAN and ASEAN-ROK cooperation across all ASEAN Member States and the ROK.

Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee has moved the Supreme Court against a Calcutta High Court order that refused him permission to travel abroad for eye treatment. The high court had dismissed his plea on August 5, saying he was unwilling to appear before a medical board at the state-run SSKM Hospital in Kolkata for an assessment of his condition. The travel request is linked to conditions imposed in a case over alleged comments made at a public meeting during the West Bengal Assembly polls. While dismissing the application, the high court said, "In view of submission made on behalf of the applicant (Banerjee) that applicant will not appear before the medical board at SSKM Hospital, Kolkata, this court finds the issue which is agitated before this court by filing application... ought not to be kept pending further." #AbhishekBanerjee #TMC #TrinamoolCongress #SupremeCourt #CalcuttaHighCourt #WestBengal #EyeTreatment #ITCard

The ASEAN Secretariat today held a commemorative ceremony of the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Convened on the sidelines of the 59th ASEAN Day celebrations, the ceremony complements the commemorative activities led by the ASEAN Chair throughout 2026 to mark the Treaty's golden anniversary. Secretary-General of ASEAN Dr. Kao Kim Hourn delivered remarks, preceded by H.E. Amb. Evangeliene T. Ong Jimenez-Ducroq, Permanent Representative of the Philippines to ASEAN and H.E. M. I. Derry Aman, Permanent Representative of Indonesia to ASEAN. The ceremony featured the inauguration of the TAC Flag Corner at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat, showcasing the flags of the 62 High Contracting Parties to the Treaty, as well as the screening of a commemorative video highlighting key milestones in the TAC's five-decade journey. Signed in 1976, the TAC remains ASEAN's foundational code of conduct governing inter-State relations in Southeast Asia. As it marks its 50th anniversary in 2026, the Treaty continues to serve as a cornerstone of regional peace, stability, and cooperation, with 62 High Contracting Parties reflecting its enduring relevance and broad international recognition. The quiz competition, organised under the name 'Freedom Quiz' on August 6 in schools in Kasaragod, Kumbla, and Manjeshwar sub-districts, was not an event included in the activity calendar of the Social Science Club or the Education Department. Neither the Education Department nor the Social Science Club had authorised anyone to locally prepare unofficial questions and conduct such a competition. In this context, the inclusion of historically inaccurate questions was viewed as objectionable. Minister N. Shamsudheen directed the Director of General Education to identify those responsible for preparing such incorrect questions and conducting the competition, and to take strict action against them. Надійний зв’язок потрібен усім, а передусім – на фронті. І всюди, де присутні наші зв’язківці, є можливість забезпечувати ефективне управління нашими операціями та відбивати російські атаки. Війська зв’язку та кібербезпеки роблять важливий внесок у захист суверенітету й територіальної цілісності України. І також із перших днів повномасштабної російської агресії зв’язківці відбили тисячі ворожих кібератак. Завдяки нашим фахівцям працює та захищена фактично вся наша державна екосистема: банки, державні установи, телебачення та й просто щоденний мобільний зв’язок для українців та українок. І саме тому, починаючи із цього року, професійний день зв’язківців буде називатися Днем Військ зв’язку та кібербезпеки Збройних Сил України. З нагоди цього професійного свята напередодні відзначив воїнів державними нагородами. Дякую за службу та захист!

आज के दिन जिस शिविर के शुभारंभ के लिए हम सभी एकत्र हुए हैं, ये निश्चित रूप से मानवता का महाअभियान है। ये महाअभियान हम सबमें इस भाव को जागृत करता है कि सेवा का संकल्प हम सबके मन में होता है। रक्तदान जीवन बचाने का सबसे पवित्र माध्यम है। अगर हम इस संकल्प के साथ जुड़ते हैं, तो हम जीवन और कार्यों से समाज के प्रति अपने दायित्वों का निर्वहन करते हैं। - श्री @NitinNabin पूरा वीडियो देखें: youtube.com/watch?v=9uGX2JoL… Video

ब्रह्मकुमारी समाज के इस प्रांगण में अध्यात्म, योग, ज्ञान का एक सुंदर मिलन मिलता है, और मुझे भी यहां एक पुण्य उद्देश्य से आने का सौभाग्य मिला। जहां एक ओर ‘रक्तदान-एक महादान’ के अभियान की शुरुआत हो रही है, वहीं नशा मुक्ति के अभियान और संकल्प को भी हम लोगों ने लिया है। हमारा मानना है कि विश्व में सबसे अधिक युवा आबादी भारत में है — उसकी ऊर्जा का संचार सही दिशा में हो, उनके विकास के साथ-साथ भारत और समाज का विकास हो, तो हम चाहते हैं कि नशा मुक्ति के इस अभियान से भारत का हर युवा जुड़े, भारत का हर परिवार जुड़े, समाज का हर वर्ग जुड़े। प्रधानमंत्री जी ने इस संकल्प को युवाओं के साथ लिया है। हम सभी भारतवासी इस अभियान को अपने संकल्प के साथ जोड़ेंगे। हम अगर 2047 में विकसित भारत बनाने का सपना देख रहे हैं, तो निश्चित रूप से इन्हीं युवाओं के बल पर वह सपना पूरा करेंगे। युवा पीढ़ी को नशे के अभिशाप से हमें दूर रखना है, ताकि हम एक सुंदर भविष्य बनाने में अपने युवा पीढ़ी का पूरा सहयोग ले पाएं। - श्री @NitinNabin Video

आज भारत का पूरा education और employment system तबाह हो चुका है। डिग्री तो मिल रही है, लेकिन हाथ में हुनर नहीं है। नई शिक्षा नीति 2020 ने 2025 तक 50% छात्रों को vocational education से जोड़ने का लक्ष्य रखा, जिसका 2% ही जमीन पर उतर सका है। सारी योजना हवा हवाई है। दूसरी तरफ़ सरकार की आर्थिक नीतियों ने रोजगार पैदा करने वाले निवेश के बजाय कुछ चुनिंदा बड़े उद्योग समूहों को फायदा पहुँचाने का काम कर रही है। भारत हर साल 50 लाख graduates तैयार करता है, लेकिन graduate स्तर की केवल 28 लाख नौकरियाँ पैदा होती हैं। यानी हर साल 22 लाख युवाओं के सपने शुरू होने से पहले ही टूट जाते हैं। Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission की भर्ती परीक्षाओं से लेकर कई अन्य भर्तियों तक, पेपर लीक उद्योग बन गया है। नौकरियाँ बिकती हैं। भर्ती माफिया फल-फूल रहा है। नौकरी उनको मिलती है जिनके पास पैसा और BJP में connections हैं। साथियों, हमने पेपर लीक के खिलाफ जंतर-मंतर पर भूख हड़ताल पर बैठे नौजवानों का साथ दिया। पिछले कई दिनों से संसद के भीतर भी हम उनके साथ हुई बर्बरता के खिलाफ आवाज़ उठा रहे हैं। अमित शाह के आदेश पर बच्चों पर pellet guns चलाए गए, water cannon चलाए गए, tear gas छोड़ी गई, बिजली का करंट छोड़कर barricades लगाए गए, कील लगी लाठियों से lathi charge किया गया और कुछ जगहों पर करंट वाली लाठियों तक का इस्तेमाल किया गया। संसद में हम लगातार इस बारे में 15 दिन से हम लोग सवाल पूछ रहे हैं लेकिन न प्रधानमंत्री जवाब दे रहे हैं, न गृह मंत्री। सरकार संसद में जवाब देने से बच रही है। क्योंकि चोर की दाढी में तिनका है। क्या यही लोकतंत्र है? क्या जनता के सवालों का जवाब देना सरकार की जिम्मेदारी नहीं है? 📍हल्द्वानी, उत्तराखण्ड

Happy Birthday, Paul Dirac! Considered to be among the greatest physicists of all time, he shared the 1933 @NobelPrize in Physics with Erwin Schrödinger 'for the discovery of new productive forms of atomic theory'. One of his most well-known contributions is the famous Dirac Equation, which merges quantum mechanics and Einstein’s special theory of relativity. The equation suggests why particles like electrons and quarks move like they do as they get close to the speed of light. It also predicts the existence of antimatter. Dirac’s work, particularly his equation, has been a critical step toward the current theories in particle physics and the development of quantum field theory.

Сьогодні вночі ударами дронів Росія вбила трьох людей у Пухівці на Київщині: дідуся, бабусю та їхнього онука. Всього лиш три роки було хлопчику. Ще четверо госпіталізованих: батьки дитини та його 15-річний брат і сусід, який прийшов на допомогу родині та був поранений під час повторного удару. У постраждалих – термічні опіки, уламкові поранення. Мої співчуття. Це був звичайний житловий будинок. Не могли цього не знати росіяни. Був також удар шести балістичних ракет по цивільній інфраструктурі в Києві. Станом на зараз відомо про одну загиблу людину. Мої співчуття рідним і близьким. Також під обстрілом перебували Донеччина, Харківщина, Сумщина, Дніпровщина, Запоріжжя, Одещина, Херсонщина, Миколаївщина, Чернігівщина та Полтавщина. Європа, Америка, Україна давно хочуть зупинити цю російську війну. Не хоче лише Путін і з усіх сил чіпляється за свою балістику та дрони, щоб продовжити воювати. Потрібно більше тиску. Нові санкції, які не дозволять цю балістику виробляти. І обов’язково потрібно більше захисту для наших людей. Антибалістика, ракети-перехоплювачі до Patriot, SAMP/T, NASAMS, HAWK та наших F-16 – все це працює й допомагає захищати життя, коли воно тут, в Україні, а не десь на складах, за тисячі кілометрів від російських ударів проти життя. Я дякую всім, хто показує лідерство й попри все передає нові пакети засобів ППО.

Last night, Russia killed three people in Pukhivka, Kyiv region, with drone strikes – a grandfather, a grandmother, and their grandson. The boy was only three years old. Four more people were hospitalized: the child’s parents, his 15-year-old brother, and a neighbor who came to the family’s aid and was wounded in a double-tap strike. The victims suffered thermal burns and shrapnel wounds. My condolences… It was an ordinary residential building. The Russians could not have been unaware of this. There was also a strike involving six ballistic missiles against civilian infrastructure in Kyiv. As of now, one person has been reported dead. My condolences to the family and loved ones. The Donetsk, Kharkiv, Sumy, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa, Kherson, Mykolaiv, Chernihiv, and Poltava regions also came under attack. Europe, America, and Ukraine have long wanted to stop this Russian war. Only Putin doesn’t want to, and he’s desperately clinging to his ballistic missiles and drones to keep the war going. More pressure is needed. New sanctions that will prevent the production of these ballistic missiles. And we definitely need more protection for our people. Anti-ballistic capabilities, interceptor missiles for Patriot, SAMP/T, NASAMS, Hawk, and our F-16s – all of this works and helps protect lives when it is here, in Ukraine, rather than sitting in warehouses thousands of kilometers away from Russian strikes against life. I thank everyone who shows leadership and, despite everything, provides new air defense packages.

The United Nations has warned that more than eight million school-age children in Sudan are out of school because of the country's civil war, putting the nation's future at serious risk. According to reports, the conflict, which has been ongoing since April 2023, has displaced millions of people. Thousands of schools have been closed or turned into shelters for displaced families, and nearly half of the country's school buildings are no longer usable for education. The UN has called on the international community to increase support for education and humanitarian assistance for Sudanese children. #TOLOnews_English

প্রত্যেক প্রাণী মৃত্যুর স্বাদ গ্রহণ করবে। মহান আল্লাহ পবিত্র কুরআনে বলেন, كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآىِٕقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ؕ প্রত্যেক প্রাণীকে মৃত্যুর স্বাদ গ্রহণ করতে হবে। মৃত্যুর পর প্রথম ঘাটি হলো কবর। অনেকে জানতে চান, কবরস্থানে বৈদ্যুতিক বাতি লাগানো, কী বলে ইসলাম? এর উত্তরে ফুকাহায়ে কেরাম বলেন, কবরস্থানে বৈদ্যুতিক বা যে কোনো ধরনের বাতি জ্বালানোর উদ্দেশ্য যদি কবরের প্রতি সম্মানপ্রদর্শন বা আলোকসজ্জা না হয়, বরং মানুষের প্রয়োজন পূরণ করা হয়, যেমন রাতে কবর দেয়া, জিয়ারতকারীদের চলাচলের সুবিধা ইত্যাদি, তাহলে কবরস্থানে বৈদ্যুতিক বাতিসহ যে কোনো ধরনের বাতি লাগানো জায়েজ হবে। রসুল (সা.) ও সাহাবিরাও প্রয়োজনে কবরস্থানে বাতি জ্বালিয়েছেন। আব্দুল্লাহ ইবনে আব্বাস (রা.) থেকে বর্ণিত এক হাদিসে এসেছে, নবী সল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়া সাল্লাম রাতে একটি কবরে প্রবেশ করলেন, তখন তাঁর জন্য বাতি জ্বালানো হলো। (সুনানে তিরমিজি: ১০৫৭) আর মৃতের উপকার হবে এ রকম বিশ্বাস থেকে বা সম্মান দেখানোর উদ্দেশ্যে কবরস্থানে বৈদ্যুতিক বাতিসহ যে কোনো ধরনের বাতি জ্বালানো নাজায়েজ। রসুল (সা.) এ রকম উদ্দেশ্যে বাতি জ্বালাতে কঠোরভাবে নিষেধ করেছেন। আবদুল্লাহ ইবনে আব্বাস রা. বলেন, রাসুল (সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়া সাল্লাম) অভিসম্পাত করেছেন ওইসব লোকের প্রতি যারা কবরের ওপর মসজিদ বানায় ও প্রদীপ জ্বালায়। (সুনানে আবি দাউদ: ৩২৩৬) #islam #muslim #IslamicNews #somoytv

جامعه‌ی هزاره، بنا به توصیف دکتر جواد صالحی، در عصر بی‌سری عمومی زندگی می‌کند. هزاره‌ها بارها قربانی شده‌اند و هربار هم برخاسته‌اند، رهبر ساخته‌اند، اما نتوانسته‌اند از این تجربه‌ها یک ساختار پاسخ‌گو، مردم‌محور و مقاوم بیرون بدهند. مشکل در تداوم این وضعیت این نیست که قدرت در دست هزاره نبوده؛ مشکل اساسی این است که هزاره‌ها هنوز نتوانسته‌اند حضور و نیروی سیاسی خود را به سازمان، تصمیم جمعی و برنامه‌ای نهاد‌محور تبدیل کنند. به‌هم‌پیوستن این مشکلات سبب شده تا جامعه‌ی هزاره توده‌ای شود. جمعیت توده‌ای ابزاری برای تصمیم‌گیری ندارد، اما درد، واکنش، خشم و امید دارد. در لحظه‌ی خطر، مردم به‌ سرعت دور یک صدا جمع می‌شوند. شور بالا می‌گیرد و همه احساس می‌کنند این بار چیزی تغییر خواهد کرد؛ اما وقتی التهاب فروکش کرد، نه راه روشنی باقی می‌ماند و نه کسی که در برابر مردم جواب بدهد. جنبش‌های تبسم و روشنایی در کابل، نماد بسیار روشنی از وضعیت توده‌ای هزاره‌ها بود. مردم دور رهبرانی که روی خاک مصلی شهید مزاری نشستند، جمع شدند و چند لحظه پس از این ماجرا، دیگر نه رهبر پاسخ‌گو در کنار مردم بود و نه مردمی پرشور در صحنه. این از خصایص اصلی جامعه‌ی توده‌ای است. برعکس، مردم غیرتوده‌ای فقط یک جمعیت توفنده نیستند؛ بلکه جامعه‌ای است که نهاد، حساب‌گیری، برنامه و رهبری پاسخ‌گو دارد. گمان می‌رود که بحران جامعه‌ی هزاره ریشه در همین نقطه داشته باشد؛ جامعه تا حدی پربار است و رنج تاریخی عمیق نیز دارد، اما هنوز گرفتار اخلاق توده‌ای است. گره اصلی در جامعه‌ی توده‌ای زمانی پیدا می‌شود که شور فروکش کند و معلوم نباشد تصمیم دیروز کجا ثبت شد، پول به دست چه کسی بود و چه کسی باید فردا جواب بدهد. میان مردم و رهبر جای خالی بزرگی برجای می‌ماند. این جای خالی را نهاد باید پر کند، ولی اغلب یک نام و یک شخص آن را پر و گاهی هم مصادره می‌کند. نهاد در درون یک جامعه تجربه را نگه می‌دارد، تصمیم را از حافظه‌ی اشخاص بیرون می‌آورد و نمی‌گذارد با رفتن یک نفر همه‌ چیز دوباره از صفر آغاز شود. هزاره‌ها خاطره کم ندارند؛ آنچه کم مانده، حافظه‌ای است که روی کاغذ، در آرشیف و در یک روش روشن کار رسوب کرده باشد. البته این وضعیت را نباید خصلت ذاتی هزاره پنداشت. مردمی که چند نسل زمین از دست داده‌اند و هرچند سال یک‌بار ناامنی و آوارگی US sanctioning power is kind of interesting because US officials didn't really know they had it and kind of stumbled into it after 9/11, which made them realize that because the dollar is the international currency and they ultimately control settlement in dollars, even foreign companies would cooperate without asking questions and even go beyond what US officials want them to do because the costs of being cut off from the dollar system are so enormous that overcompliance is actually rational from their point of view. But the same facts that give US officials so much power also imply they can't actually control that power, because it means that while they can sometimes lift the sanctions themselves, it's much harder to undo their consequences. The problem is that, as a result, sanctions lose part of their effectiveness as a foreign policy tool, because it reduces the incentives of target countries to change their behavior since US officials can't credibly promise to undo the consequences of sanctions. I think this actually explains a lot about Iran's current behavior.

ফিফা সভাপতি জিয়ান্নি ইনফান্তিনোর বিরুদ্ধে এবার গুরুতর এক অভিযোগ উঠেছে। উয়েফার সাধারণ সম্পাদক থাকাকালীন সময়ে নাকি এক নারীর সঙ্গে সম্পর্কে জড়ান তিনি। সেসময় নাকি তার সেই প্রেমিকাকে মোটা অঙ্কের অর্থও দিয়েছিলেন ইনফান্তিনো। তবে এসব অভিযোগ মিথ্যা বলে উড়িয়ে দিয়েছেন তিনি। ‘ডেইলি টেলিগ্রাফ’-এর এক অনুসন্ধানী প্রতিবেদনে দাবি করা হয়েছে, উয়েফার সাধারণ সম্পাদক হিসেবে জিয়ান্নি ইনফান্তিনোর দায়িত্ব পালনের সময় তার সঙ্গে কথিত সম্পর্ক ছিল, এমন এক নারীকে চাকরি-সমাপ্তি বাবদ ছয় অঙ্কের অর্থ দিয়েছিল ইউরোপীয় ফুটবলের নিয়ন্ত্রক সংস্থাটি। প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী, উয়েফায় ইনফান্তিনোর দায়িত্বে থাকার সময় ওই নারীর সঙ্গে তার কথিত সম্পর্কের বিষয়টি সামনে আসে। পরে সংস্থাটির পক্ষ থেকে তাকে ‘সেভারেন্স পেমেন্ট’ হিসেবে উল্লেখযোগ্য অঙ্কের অর্থ দেওয়া হয় বলে জানিয়েছে ব্রিটিশ সংবাদপত্রটি। তবে এসব অভিযোগ সরাসরি অস্বীকার করেছেন ফিফার বর্তমান সভাপতি ইনফান্তিনো। তার একজন মুখপাত্র ‘ডেইলি টেলিগ্রাফ’-কে জানিয়েছেন, ইনফান্তিনো অভিযোগগুলোকে ‘সম্পূর্ণ মিথ্যা’ বলে প্রত্যাখ্যান করছেন। ব্রিটিশ সংবাদমাধ্যমটির প্রতিবেদনে বলা হয়েছে, উয়েফার সাধারণ সম্পাদক হিসেবে দায়িত্ব পালনের সময় এক নারীর সঙ্গে কথিত সম্পর্কে জড়িয়েছিলেন ইনফান্তিনো। অভিযোগ রয়েছে, সম্পর্ক চলাকালে ওই নারীকে পদোন্নতিও দিয়েছিলেন তিনি। প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী, পরে ওই নারী উয়েফা ছাড়ার পর উচ্চশিক্ষার জন্য একটি বিজনেস স্কুলে এমবিএ করতে ভর্তি হন। তার সেই শিক্ষার ব্যয়ও উয়েফার পক্ষ থেকে বহন করা হয়েছিল বলে দাবি করেছে সংবাদমাধ্যমটি। প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী, পুরো বিষয়টি গোপন রাখার উদ্দেশ্যে ওই নারীকে ছয় অঙ্কের বেশি অর্থ পরিশোধ করেছিল উয়েফা। সংস্থাটিও এক বিবৃতিতে অর্থ দেওয়ার বিষয়টি নিশ্চিত করেছে। তবে উয়েফার ভাষ্য, সংশ্লিষ্ট নারী প্রতিষ্ঠানটি ছাড়ার সময়ই ওই অর্থ প্রদান করা হয়েছিল। ইনফান্তিনো ২০০৯ থেকে ২০১৬ সাল পর্যন্ত উয়েফার সাধারণ সম্পাদকের দায়িত্বে ছিলেন। সেই সময়কে ঘিরে ওঠা অভিযোগগুলো অবশ্য পুরোপুরি অস্বীকার করেছেন ফিফার বর্তমান সভাপতি। তিনি এসব দাবিকে ভিত্তিহীন বলে প্রত্যাখ্যান করেছেন। #FIFA #Football #SportsNews #somoytv

मुख्यमंत्री श्रीमती रेखा गुप्ता के नेतृत्व में दिल्ली कैबिनेट ने निजी विश्वविद्यालयों की स्थापना एवं संचालन संबंधी प्रारूप विधेयक को मंजूरी दी है। जल्द ही इसे विधानसभा में प्रस्तुत किया जाएगा। ⟢ दिल्ली के विद्यार्थियों के लिए प्रत्येक पाठ्यक्रम में 25% सीटें आरक्षित होंगी। ⟢ सीमित भूमि के अनुरूप मल्टी-स्टोरी और हाई-टेक कैंपस विकसित किए जा सकेंगे। ⟢ ‘दिल्ली प्राइवेट यूनिवर्सिटीज रेगुलेटरी अथॉरिटी’ गुणवत्ता, पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करेगी। ⟢ विश्वस्तरीय विश्वविद्यालयों एवं उनके ऑफ-कैंपस केंद्रों की स्थापना का मार्ग प्रशस्त होगा। ⟢ अनुसंधान, नवाचार, उद्यमिता और उद्योग-अकादमिक सहयोग को नई गति मिलेगी। मुख्यमंत्री ने कहा कि यह निर्णय केवल नए निजी विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित करने का नहीं, बल्कि दिल्ली के युवाओं को अपने ही शहर में विश्वस्तरीय उच्च शिक्षा के अवसर उपलब्ध कराने का संकल्प है। यह पहल दिल्ली को भारत की नॉलेज कैपिटल और वैश्विक उच्च शिक्षा के प्रमुख केंद्र के रूप में स्थापित करने की दिशा तय करेगी। #ViksitDelhi

Delhi | Cyber Police Station, North-East District, has arrested a fraudster, Rajeev Kumar (32), R/o Mandawali, who impersonated himself as an employee of IGI Airport and cheated a woman, Somvati, R/o Shiv Vihar, of Rs 3,03,120 on the false promise of securing a Cabin Crew job for her 20-year-old son. On the complaint of Somvati, a case E-FIR No 00061/2025 dated 03.12.2025 under Sections 318(4)/319/340 BNS was registered at Cyber Police Station, North-East District. The accused was traced and apprehended on 6th August from Madhu Vihar, Delhi, where he was working as a Security Guard at a Blinkit Store. During sustained interrogation, the accused disclosed that he had deliberately impersonated an employee of IGI Airport to gain the trust of job seekers through Facebook. He lured victims by promising airport jobs and collected money in the name of recruitment formalities, security deposits, and documentation charges. After receiving the payments, he blocked the victims on social media, deleted Facebook chats, destroyed the SIM card used in the crime, and spent the cheated amount on his personal expenses and repayment of debts in an attempt to evade detection.

The lack of sustained political resolve meant that even schools, meant to be safe spaces for children, were not adequately protected. When extremists could attack schools and put children’s future at risk, Congress failed to show the political will needed to confront the threat. The cost of that inaction was borne by students, families and several communities across the nation.

With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

🚨 INDIA EYES THE 6TH-GEN FIGHTER RACE 🇮🇳✈️ A Parliamentary panel has urged the Defence Ministry to create a concrete roadmap for acquiring or co-developing sixth-generation combat aircraft. India has initiated efforts toward the France-Germany-led FCAS programme while also evaluating the UK-Italy-Japan GCAP ecosystem. The strategy is clear: 🇮🇳 AMCA → Indigenous 5th-gen capability 🌐 FCAS/GCAP → Access to the emerging 6th-gen ecosystem AI, loyal wingmen, sensor fusion, advanced propulsion and networked warfare will define the next era of air combat. India cannot afford to enter the 6th-gen race late. The time to secure a seat at the table is NOW. 🇮🇳

🚨 INDIA IS TURNING ATTACK HELICOPTERS INTO DRONE HUNTERS 🇮🇳 The IAF is developing a new airborne counter-drone architecture built around low-cost, high-volume kills instead of expensive missiles. ⚡ 70/80mm rocket-based interceptor concepts ⚡ Fragmentation warheads against small UAVs ⚡ RF/GPS jamming for soft kills ⚡ EO/IR + AI-assisted detection & tracking ⚡ Helicopter-borne interception of low-flying drones Platforms such as LCH Prachand and Apache could become highly mobile counter-UAS nodes — rapidly repositioning to defend threatened corridors and critical infrastructure. That changes the doctrine: Instead of waiting for drones to reach the air-defence bubble, take the interceptor to the drone. The objective is simple: kill mass with mass — at a sustainable cost. 🇮🇳🛡️

🚨 RUSSIA’S DRONE WAR IS MOVING DOWN THE FUEL CHAIN Russian forces are increasingly targeting Ukraine’s local fuel distribution network — not just major refineries and depots. ▪️ Modified lightweight FPVs → reportedly reaching ~20–25 km behind the front ▪️ Lancet loitering munitions → deeper precision strikes ▪️ Petrol stations & local storage → vulnerable, dispersed targets The logic is simple: don’t just attack the fuel supply — attack the last mile delivering it to mobile units. Cheap drones forcing expensive logistical adaptation. That’s modern attrition warfare.

Companies could litigate it. Frontier AI has weakened the practical barriers that once protected institutional knowledge.

Employees can walk away with years of accumulated proprietary organisational knowledge, both explicit and tacit, carrying it in their minds. AI is amplifying this emerging form of “institutional brain drain”.

The Department of War has revoked former Secretary of the Air Force Frank Kendall's eligibility to access classified information and his ability to hold any sensitive Department of War position, citing an alleged "unauthorized disclosure of classified information regarding Air Force One's capabilities to a media outlet." Kendall served as Secretary of the Air Force from July 28, 2021, until January 20, 2025. While the Department of War has not identified the specific disclosure at issue, the action comes days after Kendall publicly commented on the capabilities of the VC-25B "Bridge" aircraft (the interim presidential aircraft converted from a Qatari-donated Boeing 747) during media reporting comparing it to the existing VC-25A fleet. Those reports highlighted that the Bridge aircraft lacks several capabilities of the legacy Air Force One fleet and will undergo additional upgrades. At this time, it remains unclear whether the revocation is directly related to those comments or to a separate alleged disclosure. Authorities are also investigating a second suspected drone that a DHL cargo aircraft reportedly struck after executing a go-around due to the airport closure, with the aircraft later landing safely despite damage to its nose. China has a name for the stubborn heat that refuses to leave – the "Autumn Tiger." 🐯☀️ A familiar expression in Chinese culture, the "Autumn Tiger" refers to a spell of hot, dry weather that often returns after the traditional start of autumn. It usually occurs from late August to early September and can last for about one to two weeks. Similar spells have other names elsewhere. In the US, a period of warm autumn weather is often called "Indian Summer" – though it is not exactly the same phenomenon – while in parts of Europe it is simply described as "late-summer heat." The names vary, but the feeling is familiar – autumn on the calendar, summer in the air. What do people call it where you live?

(Reuters) - Abu Dhabi National Oil Company said on Friday it was being significantly impacted by what it described as unprovoked attacks on its people and assets, as it sought to continue meeting customer requirements in an "exceptionally challenging environment." ADNOC said in a statement that 15 of its vessels had been attacked by missiles and drones while transiting the Strait of Hormuz since the start of the conflict, including three this week, leaving one crew member dead and 20 injured. The Strait of Hormuz, between Iran and Oman, is the world's most important oil shipping chokepoint, carrying roughly a fifth of global oil consumption. Shipping through the waterway has been repeatedly disrupted since the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran expanded into a wider regional conflict, with attacks on commercial vessels raising freight rates and security concerns. ADNOC, the Abu Dhabi state oil company, is one of the world's largest energy producers and exports crude oil, natural gas and refined products to customers worldwide. ADNOC said it was working closely with relevant authorities and taking all necessary measures to protect its people, assets and operations, while meeting customer requirements as much as possible. "Freedom of navigation and the safe, uninterrupted passage of commercial shipping through international waterways must be respected and protected without threat, harassment or attack," ADNOC said.

The Polk County Sheriff's Office is pleased to report that K9 Ace's surgery went well. Unfortunately, Ace's front left leg was too damaged, and it had to be amputated. Ace is currently in stable condition. Thank you to the staff at Veterinary Medical Center at Lakewood Ranch for their work on our fuzzy guy, and thank you to the Wiltse Family Trust who has offered to pay for Ace's treatment in Bradenton. Ace's partner, Deputy Natalie Oestreich can be seen in the foreground of this photo. She has remained by Ace's side since he was shot last night. #PCSO #PolkSheriff #Ace

There are so many people and organizations that the Polk County Sheriff’s Office would like to acknowledge and thank for their part in getting our K9 Ace the help he needed after he was shot by a suspect on Thursday, August 6, 2026. Immediately after he was wounded, Ace was taken to Parkway Veterinary Emergency Clinic in Lakeland where his bleeding was stopped and he was stabilized by Dr. Oscar Aguayo and his team. Once stabilized, Ace was picked up by Tampa General Hospital’s Aeromed helicopter with pilot Chad Loftin (Metro Aviation), Chief Flight Nurse Tracy Sanderson (TGH), and Flight Paramedic Kenny Switzer (TGH). Aeromed transported Ace to Veterinary Medical Center at Lakewood Ranch in Bradenton to be cared for by Dr. Devon Diaz and his team. Ace is a 7-year-old German Shepherd. He has been with the Polk County Sheriff’s Office since March of 2020. He was shot in the front left leg. The bullet broke his leg and tore an artery which caused him to lose a lot of blood. The PCSO is truly grateful for the tremendous outpouring of support from our community. We appreciate the support for our deputies involved last night, and of course for Ace and his well-being. Many have reached out to the PCSO asking if there was anything they could do. Polk Sheriff’s Charities, Inc. has an established K9 Fund that will be used to support K9 Ace’s care. For those who have asked how they can help, donations may be made directly to the K9 Fund through the link below. Once on the donation page, simply select “K9” from the dropdown menu. polksheriff.org/donate The Wiltse Family Trust has already informed us that they intend to cover the cost for Ace’s care at Veterinary Medical Center the Lakewood Ranch AND the Trust has already committed to purchasing a new K9 to replace Ace now that he will have to retire. Again, we sincerely appreciate the continued support, kindness, and generosity shown to our K9 Unit during this difficult time. #PCSO #K9Ace Parkway Veterinary Emergency Clinic TGH Aeromed Veterinary Medical Center at LWR

Earlier today, the U.S. Senate passed Senate Bill 5025, the “Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia Act of 2026”, by a margin of 86-11 sending the bill to the U.S. House of Representatives. Key provisions include: • Up to 500% tariffs on goods imported directly from Russia. • Up to 100% tariffs on imports from the largest purchasers of Russian crude oil and natural gas, as well as countries determined to be facilitating Russian sanctions evasion. • Expanded sanctions targeting Russian government officials, banks, energy companies, vessels involved in sanctions evasion, and entities supporting Russia's defense industrial base. • New restrictions on investment in Russia, Russian energy exports, uranium imports, sovereign debt purchases, and access to international financial messaging systems. If enacted, the legislation would represent one of the most comprehensive U.S. sanctions packages against Russia since the start of the war in Ukraine, while also increasing economic pressure on third countries that continue purchasing Russian energy.

This is Professor Roland Fryer on @triggerpod discussing the reaction to his paper, particularly its findings on police use of lethal force. He received death threats, required police protection (ironic), and was suspended from the Harvard faculty over a handful of jokes that supposedly created a “hostile work environment.” His research lab was shut down for good measure. The old Twitter before @elonmusk bought it, flagged and suspended accounts simply for posting the paper, branding it as hate speech. They had endless tolerance for Arday’s lies. They went after Fryer for speaking the truth. Video Melissa Chen (@MsMelChen) To understand just how irredeemably messed up academia is, compare the differences in how Cambridge treated Jason Arday and how Harvard treated Roland Fryer. One is a black sociologist; the other is a black economist. At this point, we are all very well acquainted with Jason Arday’s insane fabrications, plagiarism, and less-than-stellar research record. Yet he became the youngest black professor in Cambridge’s history at 37. Now look at the case of Roland Fryer. He produced rigorous, data-driven research, published extensively, and ran a major institute (EdLabs) at Harvard. He doggedly pursued the truth on one of the most charged questions in American public life. His landmark 2016 study titled “An Empirical Analysis of Racial Differences in Police Use of Force” examined millions of encounters and officer-involved shootings. It found that there were no racial differences in the raw data or after controlling for circumstances. In some datasets (notably Houston), blacks were actually less likely to be shot once the encounter was underway. As you know, this finding directly contradicted Black Lives Matter’s core orthodoxy that police systematically and disproportionately kill Black men out of racial animus. It was not only in vogue at the time; it was literally religion. Roland Fryer and his data were guilty of blasphemy. Harvard launched investigations into allegations of verbal sexual harassment and a hostile work environment in his lab. The process produced a two-year unpaid suspension, the permanent shutdown of EdLabs, and severe restrictions on his ability to advise or supervise. All this was investigated by a kangaroo court under Title IX. The recommendation for his alleged failings was sensitivity training, yet a faculty panel escalated it into career-crippling punishment. Fryer has said he was unfairly targeted because of the political inconvenience of his results. The contrast between how the academy treated these two men shows you how deep the moral rot is. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/MsMelChen/status/2085519219202965693#m

Texas Children’s will also pay $10 million, with more than $8 million going to the state, to resolve claims they billed Texas Medicaid for illegal "gender-transition" interventions. $1.7 million will also go to whistleblower Vanessa Sivadge. The settlement also requires the hospital to revoke the privileges of five doctors associated or previously associated with the hospital. “This historic settlement is a resounding defeat for the radical gender ideology that has preyed on Texas children under the guise of ‘care,’” Attorney General Ken Paxton said.

#EsPuria #Fraudia #02DeJunioFueFraude josexebex (@jose_anbriz) Ya ven lo que les está pasando a los presidentes espurios, señora Claudia. ¡ Se comprueba nuevamente el fraude en la elección presidencial de México del domingo 2 de junio de 2024 ! Claudia Sheinbaum no ganó en las urnas y está usurpando el cargo de Presidenta de la República. El 28 de septiembre de 2025, Ayo López Vital y sus expertos cibernéticos del Conteo Ciudadano (CC) publicaron un video que reveló fehacientemente el fraude en la elección presidencial, al descubrir que el 52.2% de las actas de la elección carecen de metadatos o tienen los metadatos alterados, un requisito que exigen los Manuales del INE, para saber dónde fueron capturadas esas actas, en base a la geolocalización (GPS), así como que hayan sido capturadas con el software oficial, el Kotlin, y que se haya respetado la "cadena de custodia"... Una nueva revisión realizada por La Carpeta Púrpura, encontró que hay un 5.6% de actas adicionales que no tienen metadatos, y que representan 9,820 actas. Es decir que hay 98 mil 757 actas "piratas", lo cual es suficiente para anular la elección ya que la ley establece que cuando hay un 25% de inconsistencias se debe declarar inválida y aquí las inconsistencias son del ¡¡¡ 57.9% !!! Sin metadatos no se puede validar la procedencia de esas actas, pero tampoco que reflejen votos reales... Presumiblemente fueron actas que se llenaron días antes de la elección. Informantes que pidieron confidencialidad nos han dicho que fueron llenadas en Palacio Nacional semanas o meses antes de los comicios y que el gobierno utilizó a los 21 "siervos" de la nación para romper la "cadena de custodia", aprovechando que el INE había sido dominado por Morena con Guadalupe Taddei y que también le habían dado "golpe de estado" al Tribunal Electoral Federal, con Mónica Soto... Esto permitió hacer el "crimen perfecto". Una revisión acta por acta de las 170 mil 616 actas de la elección, permitió saber que Xóchitl ganó en 21 estados, con el 51.4% de los votos. Esto fue demostrado con el Conteo Ciudadano de "Sábanas" que enviaron más de 100 mil ciudadanos y que al revisarse y depurarse para eliminar duplicados quedaron casi 17 mil actas, que representan el 10% de la elección y que comprueban que Claudia Sheinbaum perdió la elección. La crítica que se hizo de que faltaba el 90% de las actas, se invalida al revisar puntualmente cada una de ellas y comprobar que se trata en más de la mitad, de actas falsas, apócrifas, piratas, en un 52.2% de acuerdo a los criterios más estrictos que siguió Ayo y los expertos informáticos y de 57.9% si se incluyen todas las actas que no tienen metadatos o que tienen metadatos alterados, tal como se puede ver en el cuadro resumen. Un Notario Público ya dio fe del 10% de las actas donde se tienen "sábanas" y que demuestran el triunfo de Xóchitl Gálvez. En tanto que estamos esperando que un perito judicial, de un Tribunal Internacional Independiente verifique los metadatos de las 171 mil actas, para comprobar que más de la mitad de ellas no cumplen con la normatividad del INE, porque no fueron capturadas por el software oficial y no tienen geolocalización. Esa es una prueba dura del fraude. Existe suficiente evidencia para declarar formalmente que AMLO y Claudia y su partido Morena se robaron la elección presidencial con la complicidad del INE Chairo y del Tribunal Electoral al que previamente habían sometido. Pero no es la única prueba: 8,131 actas no tienen el Código de Integridad. - Clonaron 850 actas como descubrió "Gommo" - firmaron 2000 actas con votos en blanco como demostró Partido Neoliberal. - usaron a los 21 mil siervos de la nación como presidentes o secretarios de casilla para suplantar las urnas y las actas y violar la "cadena de custodia". - Claudia hizo 3 años de campaña cuando la ley sólo le autorizaba 3 meses. - Claudia y AMLO se gastaron 85 mil millones de pesos para comprar votos cuando la ley sólo permitía que cada candidato gastara 500 millones de pesos en su campaña. - Duplicaron papelería electoral que imprimieron fuera de los Talleres Gráficos de la Nación. - Violaron la ciberseguridad del sistema informático del INE para poder meter sus actas pirata. - Inflaron el padrón electoral con más de 6.6 millones de migrantes o muertos o duplicados. - Quintuplicaron artificialmente la votación de los partidos aliados de Morena, el PV y MC, a los que les dieron 11 millones de votos, para forzar la sobrepresentación legislativa. - Inhibieron el voto de la oposición real al no mandar 4 millones de boletas a las casillas donde se presumía que ganaría Xóchitl. - Practicaron el tortuguismo electoral en el extranjero y en territorio nacional. - Plancharon votos como fue denunciado incluso por dos consejeros electorales del INE, pero Taddei se hizo "pato" y no lo investigó ni lo sancionó. De todo ello hay evidencias, pruebas, testimonios, pero ni el INE ni el Tribunal Electoral quisieron investigar o sancionar. Aparte se hicieron 9 violaciones Constitucionales que están totalmente documentadas y acreditadas. Hay ya una denuncia penal que se interpuso por el abogado penalista, el licenciado Guillermo Hamdan, en tiempo y forma, ante la Fiscalía General de la República (FGR), a la cual está adscrita la Fiscalía de Delitos Electorales, la cual está en curso. Conviene recordar que los delitos penales no prescriben así el INE y el Tribunal Electoral hayan dado por concluido el proceso electoral y Claudia haya tomado posesión de la presidencia de forma ilegal e ilegítimamente. Por todo ello se declara que Claudia Sheinbaun no ganó la elección, no obtuvo el voto popular, no está acreditado su triunfo, por lo cual está usurpando el cargo de Presidenta de la República y que también la sobrerepresentación legislativa es antiConstitucional, así como su reforma judicial con la que hicieron su #NarcoEleccionJudicial y la desaparición de la Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación (SCJN), la desaparición de los órganos autónomos como el INAI, la afectación del juicio de amparo, etc. Todo ello se caerá cuando los ciudadanos recuperen su libertad y el poder y se aplique el Artículo 136 Constitucional, para revertir las ilegalidades que hicieron los rebeldes narco comunistas y México recupere nuevamente su Estado de Derecho, su Constitución, su Democracia y sus libertades, en especial la del sufragio efectivo a través de elecciones libres, que sean 100% auditables. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/jose_anbriz/status/2085440115476979789#m

The Al Areesh departed Qatar's Ras Laffan LNG terminal and transited the Strait of Hormuz outbound on July 29, utilizing Iran's traffic separation scheme, according to publicly available AIS tracking data from MarineTraffic.com. Its continued inability to proceed beyond the apparent blockade line is notable because the vessel does not appear to have loaded cargo in Iran or be associated with an Iranian port, and therefore does not appear to fit the publicly understood criteria for vessels subject to the U.S. naval blockade. It remains unclear whether the vessel's unusual movements are the result of instructions from its owner or operator, operational considerations, or direction from U.S. forces.

In his opening remarks, High Commissioner @AmbAbhishekIFS highlighted the importance of food security and encouraged Nigeria to leverage India's expertise in improved seeds, mechanized farming, and agricultural technology to boost productivity. He also highlighted India's collaboration with the *National Dairy Development Board (NDDB)* and cooperative clusters in *Jigawa State* to strengthen dairy farming, milk collection, and animal healthcare. HC further emphasized the nutritional, economic, and environmental benefits of millet and encouraged greater adoption of millet-based products. Reaffirming the High Commission's commitment to promoting bilateral trade and investment, *HC* launched the *India–Nigeria Business WhatsApp Group*, a platform connecting Indian exporters, Nigerian importers, industry associations, and policymakers. ADNOC says 15 of its vessels have been attacked by Iranian missiles or drones since the start of the war, including three this week, underscoring the continued risks to commercial shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz. According to ADNOC, one crew member has been killed and 20 others injured as the company works to keep crude oil, LNG and refined products flowing despite repeated attacks. Before the war, the Strait of Hormuz carried roughly 20% of global oil consumption, but vessel attacks have driven up insurance and freight costs while discouraging some shipowners from entering the Persian Gulf. Despite the security environment, ADNOC is expanding its fleet, announcing the acquisition of 11 VLCC and VLGC vessels worth approximately $1.3 billion to support future export capacity.

Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have signed the 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement', pledging that an armed attack on one will be treated as an attack on all, creating a new trilateral security framework amid the expanding Middle East conflict. The agreement stops short of detailing automatic military obligations, but it formalizes closer defense coordination between three of the Muslim world's most influential militaries. Saudi Arabia has come under repeated Iranian attacks since the start of Operation Epic Fury, Turkey fields NATO's second-largest military, and Pakistan is the only nuclear-armed Muslim-majority nation. The pact follows nearly a year of negotiations and reflects growing concern that regional states may need to rely more on their own security architecture as the Iran conflict continues to threaten Gulf energy infrastructure and shipping. Turkish and Saudi officials stressed the agreement is defensive in nature and is not directed at any specific country.

The WHO technical advisory group on vaccine research met last Friday to review new data on the Ervebo vaccine, the only licensed vaccine against Ebola virus disease. New data from two animal studies show that Ervebo offers some protection against Bundibugyo virus disease, particularly against dying from the disease. The studies were done following WHO's call for more research. Given this new information, and that there are no safety concerns for this vaccine, the group recommends that the Ervebo vaccine be prioritized for a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo during the ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak. To gather data that can be used for policy decisions as quickly as possible, WHO recommends that it be evaluated in a priority clinical trial using a ring vaccination design, a design which has been used successfully in the past. WHO is working with partners to start this trial as soon as possible. The trial is a step towards expanding use of the vaccine, if it is shown to protect people from the disease. Working with communities will be important for acceptance and involvement in the trial. The advisory group will continue to review new data and evidence when available to adjust their recommendations as needed. Read more: bit.ly/4fK9pch

संन्यास के एक हफ्ते बाद ही मिली नई टीम, यूरोपियन T20 प्रीमियर लीग में Amsterdam Flames के लिए खेलेंगे Ajinkya Rahane भारतीय टेस्ट टीम के पूर्व उप-कप्तान अजिंक्य रहाणे को संन्यास के एक हफ्ते बाद ही एक नई टीम मिल गई है. रहाणे ने यूरोपियन T20 प्रीमियर लीग (ETPL) के पहले सीजन में खेलने का फैसला किया है. अपने शानदार भारतीय करियर को विराम देने वाले रहाणे इस फ्रेंचाइजी लीग में एम्सटर्डम फ्लेम्स (Amsterdam Flames) के लिए खेलेंगे. यह टूर्नामेंट आयरलैंड और नीदरलैंड में 26 अगस्त से 20 सितंबर 2026 तक आयोजित होने वाला है. रहाणे ने खुलासा किया उन्होंने संन्यास के ऐलान के साथ ही यह तय कर लिया था वह इस लीग में खेलेंगे. उन्होंने बताया कि संन्यास के तुरंत बाद उन्हें यह मौका मिला. दिग्गज ऑस्ट्रेलियाई खिलाड़ी स्टीव वॉ ने खुद उन्हें फोन किया और अपनी टीम के लिए खेलने का प्रस्ताव दिया. रहाणे ने इस पर विचार करने के लिए एक दिन का समय लिया और फिर हां कर दी. . . 38 वर्षीय रहाणे का मानना है कि इतने सालों के अनुभव और सही मानसिकता के साथ, यह उनके लिए वैश्विक स्तर पर प्रभाव डालने का एक बेहतरीन मौका है. वह अन्य खिलाड़ियों के साथ अपना अनुभव साझा करने के लिए बहुत उत्साहित हैं. रहाणे को विश्वास है कि यह लीग यूरोप, खासकर आयरलैंड और नीदरलैंड जैसे देशों में क्रिकेट के विकास को तेज करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाएगी. उन्होंने इन देशों के खिलाड़ियों के सीखने के जज्बे और क्रिकेट के प्रति उनके जुनून की जमकर तारीफ की है. ETPL का सबसे बड़ा फायदा स्थानीय खिलाड़ियों को मिलने वाला एक्सपोजर होगा. स्टीव स्मिथ, मिचेल मार्श जैसे सितारों और राहुल द्रविड़ व मैथ्यू हेडन जैसे दिग्गजों की मौजूदगी में युवा यूरोपीय क्रिकेटरों को खुद को निखारने का अनोखा मौका मिलेगा. एम्सटर्डम फ्लेम्स के सह-संस्थापक स्टीव वॉ रहाणे के जुड़ने से बेहद खुश हैं. उन्होंने कहा कि रहाणे एक पेशेवर क्रिकेटर की हर खूबी (कौशल, लचीलापन, विनम्रता और नेतृत्व) का प्रतीक हैं और उनका अनुभव टीम की संस्कृति बनाने में अमूल्य होगा. टीम के सीईओ टिम थॉमस ने रहाणे के साथ अनुबंध को फ्रेंचाइजी के लिए एक ऐतिहासिक पल बताया है. उन्होंने कहा कि यह केवल एक महान क्रिकेटर को जोड़ने के बारे में नहीं है, बल्कि क्लब के भविष्य के लिए उच्च मानक और लक्ष्य स्थापित करने के बारे में है. #AjinkyaRahane #Cricket #AmsterdamFlames #ETPL

The Makkah Joint Defense Agreement with Turkey and Pakistan is the product of years of careful negotiation and decades of strategic ties. It commits all three nations to treat any external attack on one as an attack on all. We hope that this step will help all three countries develop sustainable, integrated defense capabilities and stronger deterrence. The agreement does not reflect aims for forming a military axis or sectarian bloc, nor does it represent efforts to pursue nuclear ambitions or an arms race. This agreement in no way diminishes the Kingdom’s robust strategic relations with its Gulf, Arab, U.S., allies and international partners. It poses no threat to the security of any state in the region, nor does it supersede or replace any existing bilateral or multilateral agreements. AMB Dr. Rayed Krimly (@Rayedkrimly) The Makkah Joint Defense Agreement reflects the depth and longstanding nature of the strategic relations among the three countries, which have developed over several decades, and represents the culmination of detailed negotiations conducted over a number of years. The Makkah Joint Defense Agreement enables the three signatory countries to develop joint defense capabilities, strengthen strategic deterrence, enhance readiness, and further develop and integrate their respective defense capabilities to jointly address any threats to their safety and security. Under the agreement, any external armed attack against any one of the three countries shall be regarded as an attack against all three. The agreement does not represent an effort to establish a military axis or a sectarian bloc. Nor is it linked to any nuclear ambitions or arms race, rather it is focused on building sustainable capabilities. The agreement does not come at the expense of the Kingdom’s strong and strategic relations with its Gulf, Arab, and international partners. It does not constitute a threat to the security of any country in the region, nor does it represent an escalation of tensions between any two states. The agreement does not supersede or replace any existing bilateral or multilateral agreements between these countries, or between them and other states or international organizations. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Rayedkrimly/status/2085699638145769762#m

पुण्यश्लोक अहिल्यादेवी होळकर शेतकरी कर्जमुक्ती योजनेच्या लाभ वितरणास प्रारंभ मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे 'पुण्यश्लोक अहिल्यादेवी होळकर शेतकरी कर्जमुक्ती योजना 2026' संदर्भात आढावा बैठक पार पडली. यावेळी मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते कर्जमुक्ती योजनेच्या ऑनलाइन लाभ वितरणास प्रारंभ करण्यात आला. राज्यातील प्रत्येक पात्र शेतकऱ्याला पुण्यश्लोक अहिल्यादेवी होळकर शेतकरी कर्जमुक्ती योजनेचा लाभ मिळणार असून, शेतकरी सक्षम, शेती समृद्ध आणि महाराष्ट्र अधिक प्रगत करण्याच्या उद्देशाने राज्य शासनाने ही महत्त्वाकांक्षी योजना जाहीर केली आहे. शेतकऱ्यांना आर्थिकदृष्ट्या सक्षम करण्याच्या दिशेने हा महत्त्वपूर्ण निर्णय घेतला असून, योजनेच्या पहिल्या टप्प्यात 6,22,207 पात्र शेतकऱ्यांच्या कर्जखात्यांमध्ये ₹5029 कोटींची रक्कम मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते थेट ऑनलाइन हस्तांतरित करण्यात आली. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पहिल्या टप्प्यात आधार प्रमाणीकरण पूर्ण झालेल्या शेतकऱ्यांच्या कर्जखात्यांमध्ये रक्कम थेट जमा करण्यात आली आहे. राज्य शासनाने सर्व बँकांना कर्जमुक्तीचा लाभ मिळालेल्या पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना तातडीने खरीप पीक कर्ज उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे निर्देश दिले आहेत, जेणेकरून शेतकऱ्यांना नव्याने शेतीसाठी आवश्यक आर्थिक बळ मिळेल. ही योजना पूर्णपणे ऑनलाइन असून, शेतकऱ्यांना कुठेही अर्ज करण्याची आवश्यकता नाही. योजनेतील पात्र लाभार्थ्यांची यादी संबंधित बँकांनी महाआयटीने विकसित केलेल्या पोर्टलवर अपलोड केली असून, ग्रामपंचायत कार्यालये, विविध कार्यकारी सेवा सहकारी संस्था तसेच संबंधित बँक शाखांमध्येही प्रसिद्ध करण्यात आली आहे. या यादीतील प्रत्येक शेतकऱ्याला एक विशिष्ट क्रमांक देण्यात आला आहे. हा क्रमांक घेऊन शेतकऱ्यांनी आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्रावर ॲग्रीस्टॅकवरील नोंदणी करून आधार प्रमाणीकरण करावे, एवढी सहज आणि सोपी प्रक्रिया असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. ज्या जिल्ह्यांमध्ये शेतकऱ्यांच्या अडचणी अथवा प्रलंबित बाबी असतील, त्या संबंधित पालकमंत्र्यांनी निदर्शनास आणून द्याव्यात, त्या सर्व विषयांवर मंत्रिमंडळ उपसमितीमध्ये सविस्तर चर्चा करून सकारात्मक निर्णय घेतला जाईल, असे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. पुण्यश्लोक #OTD in 1942, U.S. Marines with the 1st Marine Division launched the first major amphibious landing of World War II in the Pacific, known as Operation Watchtower, on the island of Guadalcanal. Guadalcanal was a strategic location, securing Allied supply lines between the U.S. and Australia. To threaten these supply lines, Imperial Japan began building an airfield, which was seized and completed by the Marines and later named Henderson Field. The six-month campaign was marked by fierce encounters. At the Battle of Edson’s Ridge, outnumbered Marines repelled Imperial Japanese assaults, and at the Battle for Henderson Field, Sgt. John Basilone’s legendary defense earned him the Medal of Honor. The Guadalcanal campaign marked a turning point in the Pacific War, crippling Imperial Japanese forces’ offensive capability and forcing them onto the defensive. By February 9, 1943, the Imperial Japanese forces withdrew, ending the campaign and paving the way for Allied control of the Solomon Islands. ✍️(U.S. Marine Corps Graphic by Lance Cpl. For weeks, U.S. immigration officials alerted their colleagues about dangerous overcrowding at 26 Federal Plaza, where detainees were held in small rooms with no beds, showers or full-time medical staff. In the first four days of June 2025, the number of detainees in Hold Room 1, one of four holding rooms on the building's 10th floor, jumped from approximately eight to more than 80. The room is a square cell roughly 30 feet on each side, with hard floors, concrete benches and three metal toilets. The spaces reeked of unwashed bodies. People slept sitting up because there wasn’t enough space to lie down. And because of a shortage of medical staff, people with serious health conditions, including tuberculosis, an ovarian cyst and kidney failure, lacked proper care, texts and emails among ICE officials show. DHS declined to answer a detailed list of questions about its treatment of detainees at 26 Federal Plaza and temporary holding rooms around the country, citing the ongoing litigation. There are no laws governing the amount of space immigrant detainees must be provided within ICE field offices. Read the full story: wapo.st/4fXbdgY Video
